# THIS IS A DEMO VERSION!
# FULL GAME AVAILABLE HERE:
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/marrow-marrow/9173719072733985/











































































[media]
Find your flow as you chain together dashes, wallrides and the grapple claw yoink. Soon, you’ll find yourself gliding through levels, weaving in deadly attacks. Alternate mech legs let you slide across the ground to build momentum or hover in mid-air as you rain down attacks.
[media]
Tear through your enemies from afar with the gatling-style heavy fire of the Despot or up close with its bouncing slugshots. Perhaps all you need is one well-timed shot from the powerful Railslayer to pierce your enemies.
[media]
Call in orbital strikes, emit static discharge, or spread withering rot with every shot. Grow your strength with rogue-like upgrades that amplify your abilities. Whether you wish to bolster your defenses, accelerate your movement or amplify your weaponry, there is a path.
[media]
Whether it’s the Apostate’s razor sharp scythes or the blazing projectiles of the Acolyte, each enemy brings its own deadly weaponry. Anticipate barrages from the Carrion Prowler and evade the sweeping laser of the Asterophore. Only the truly skilled will reach the sacred Terminus and face off against the vile Hierophant.
[media]
Each run brings you more in tune with the movement and allow you to traverse more freely and nimbly than you ever thought possible. When gliding through the levels becomes second nature, you are an unstoppable force of vermin annihilation.

Music: Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
